site.name: Willow Vale
site.subtitle: Bowman, Mid Coast NSW
site.source: NSW LiDAR, Upper Manning survey (March 2018), 2 m bare-earth elevation model from ELVIS, resampled to the 1 m map grid
site.boundaryNote: Property outline from the NSW property register (all lots together, about ±1–2 m).
site.soilNote: Ground from 2018 LiDAR (2 m): gullies, banks and tracks show under the trees. Points are sparse (about 1 per m²), so features under 2–3 m wide are smoothed.

catch.name: Everything that drains into Willow Vale
